metadata.selection_rule: the sole candidate must have positive mean daily RankIC on the frozen 22-session label, at least 0.95 coverage, and absolute rank correlation below 0.70 versus Alpha158_20 and every frozen same-provider price-volume candidate through v2.4
metadata.formation_policy: At each close, calculate the mean daily RMB trading amount over the current and prior 20 Provider sessions only when at least 16 observations are present. Negate the mean so lower-RMB-volume stocks receive higher scores. The score is first tradable at the following session open.
metadata.holding_policy: Use only the paper-supported one-month Rtv1 horizon: a 22-session forward label, Top 50, n_drop=1, and a 21-session minimum holding period. Do not alter the window, direction, label, validation segment, or execution contract after viewing results.
metadata.paper_definition: Rtv is the average daily RMB trading volume over the prior month. The paper reports negative high-minus-low Rtv spreads at every 1-, 3-, 6-, 9-, and 12-month holding horizon, including the post-2007 sample. The technical definition requires at least 75% of daily records.
metadata.paper_proxy_difference: The paper uses previous-calendar-month formation, Mainboard breakpoints, value-weighted quintiles, and a high-minus-low portfolio. QuantaAlpha uses a rolling 21-session amount mean with at least 16 observations in the point-in-time CSI300 universe and a long-only staggered TopK strategy. This is a tradable mechanism proxy, not an exact paper replication.

61c75b5b09f24f51.factor_description: Negative of average daily RMB trading amount over the latest 21 Provider sessions, emitted only when at least 16 amount observations exist. Higher scores identify lower-RMB-volume CSI300 stocks.
61c75b5b09f24f51.factor_formulation: score_t = -mean(amount_d), d in [t-20, t], valid observations >= 16; signal after close t, earliest execution at open t+1

metadata.hypothesis: Within the point-in-time CSI300 universe, stocks with lower average RMB trading amount over the latest month outperform high-RMB-volume stocks over the next month.
